faq.q: How much do prefab homes cost in Konya?
faq.a: Konya prefab home prices vary by square meters, model (1+1, 2+1, 3+1) and materials used. We provide a custom quote after a free site visit. Call us at 0332 351 80 60.

faq.q: What sets Erdem Prefabrik apart among Konya prefab home companies?
faq.a: Since 2003, Erdem Prefabrik has been producing prefab homes, modular structures and containers from Karatay, Konya. With over 20 years of experience, 1000+ completed projects and quality materials, we serve Konya and all of Turkey.

faq.q: How long does prefab home installation take?
faq.a: Depending on project size, prefab home installation typically takes from a few weeks to a few months. We offer fast installation times with our modular and container solutions.

aboutSection.title: About Us
aboutSection.p1: Since 2003, Erdem Prefabrik has been active in the prefabricated building sector. We produce quality and aesthetic solutions suited to modern living needs.
aboutSection.p2: Our experienced team uses the latest technologies to turn our customers' dream living spaces into reality. Quality, reliability and customer satisfaction are our core values.
aboutSection.satisfactionDesc: We are an industry leader with a 98% customer satisfaction rate.

aboutTabs.missionText: We turn our customers' dream living spaces into reality by offering quality and aesthetic prefabricated building solutions suited to modern living needs. We combine technology and craftsmanship to produce durable, fast and economical structures.
aboutTabs.visionText: As a leading and trusted brand in the prefabricated building sector, we build tomorrow's living spaces today with sustainable, energy-efficient and user-focused solutions.
aboutTabs.storyText: Our journey that began at workshop scale in 2003 has grown into a company producing comfortable living and working spaces across Turkey. In every project, we progressed without compromising on fast delivery, strength and aesthetics. We became a team that truly listens to our customers' needs. This approach has driven us to develop better solutions and become a trusted brand in the industry.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how your personal data is processed when you visit the website ("Site") operated by Erdem Prefabrik ("Company") and use contact forms. We value the security of your personal data and act in compliance with applicable legislation (KVKK and related regulations).

sections.title: 1. Data Collected
sections.body: Through the Site, contact data such as name, phone, email and message content may be processed; IP address, browser information and usage data may be processed via cookies.

sections.title: 2. Processing Purposes
sections.body: To respond to your requests and questions, provide quotes; improve our services and Site experience; fulfill our legal obligations.

sections.title: 3. Legal Basis
sections.body: Data may be processed within the scope of establishing/performing a contract, our legitimate interests or your explicit consent (KVKK Art. 5). Visit data is collected according to your cookie preferences.

sections.title: 4. Transfer
sections.body: When necessary, data may be shared with our suppliers and hosting/infrastructure providers, and with authorized institutions as required by law. Cross-border transfers comply with KVKK Art. 9.

sections.title: 5. Retention Periods
sections.body: Contact records are kept for a reasonable period or the statutory limitation period; they are securely deleted/anonymized when the purpose ceases.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights
sections.body: Under KVKK Art. 11, you have the right to access, request correction/deletion, restrict processing and object. You may submit requests via the contact details below.

sections.title: 7. Cookies
sections.body: The Site may use essential cookies and performance/analytics cookies. You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings. Disabling cookies may limit some functionality.
